source_parameters.value: Lorsque les hommes évoquent la «Terreur féministe», ils la rattachent au combat pour la PMA pour tou·tes ou à l'écriture inclusive. citations.translated_citation: When men speak of “Feminist Terror,” they associate it with the fight for assisted reproduction for everyone or with gender-inclusive writing. Even in their delusional articles and fantasies of matriarchy, these gentlemen are incapable of imagining, for even a single second, women organizing as a group to kill the rapists whom the justice system has left at liberty.
